collision_graph.interpretation: disjoint union of cliques indexed by common matrix_order; this is an arithmetic order-invariant graph only

guards: factor certificates are authoritative; no full 3^k state enumeration is claimed
parallel chunking changes execution only, not factor/order semantics
matrix-order collisions do not identify external carriers
